name: DiPlay
desc: Original DiPlay release for compatible Android head units. Includes the upstream USB and wireless CarPlay workflows.
note: Compatibility depends on the head unit and iPhone. See the upstream release notes.

name: TS7Play
desc: TS7 Android launcher with DiPlay built into the same APK. Application ID: com.hilllaoya.ts7play.
note: No runtime CarPlay authentication is bundled. Standalone iPhone connection requires valid authentication; hardware acceptance is still pending.
